# `thaumcraft.api` reference

Every public type and member of the add-on API, generated from its Javadoc. The guides are in [../README.md](../README.md); start with [getting started](../guide/getting-started.md).

## [thaumcraft.api](thaumcraft.api.md)

The public Thaumcraft API of the 1.21.1 port.

| Type | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`BlockCoordinates`](thaumcraft.api.md#blockcoordinates) | The original TC4 mutable block coordinate. |
| [`IArchitect`](thaumcraft.api.md#iarchitect) | The Architect focus capability of the original TC4 API. |
| [`IGoggles`](thaumcraft.api.md#igoggles) | Original in-world popup opt-in; wearing armor alone grants no popup ability. |
| [`IRepairable`](thaumcraft.api.md#irepairable) | Original Repair-enchantment eligibility marker; not innate self-repair. |
| [`IRepairableExtended`](thaumcraft.api.md#irepairableextended) | Original optional per-item repair hook, invoked before the inventory vis payment. |
| [`IRunicArmor`](thaumcraft.api.md#irunicarmor) | Item callback for contribution to runic shielding, measured in shield charge points rather than durability or vis. |
| [`IScribeTools`](thaumcraft.api.md#iscribetools) | TC4 marker for an item whose remaining durability supplies research ink. |
| [`IThaumcraftAddon`](thaumcraft.api.md#ithaumcraftaddon) | The point where an add-on does its Thaumcraft registrations. |
| [`IVisDiscountGear`](thaumcraft.api.md#ivisdiscountgear) | Aspect-aware equipment discount callback; values are integer percentage points, not cost multipliers or centivis. |
| [`IWarpingGear`](thaumcraft.api.md#iwarpinggear) | Original thaumcraft.api.IWarpingGear: an item that adds warp to whoever holds or wears it, for as long as it is held or worn. |
| [`ItemApi`](thaumcraft.api.md#itemapi) | The original TC4 reflective item/block lookup. |
| [`ItemRunic`](thaumcraft.api.md#itemrunic) | The original TC4 runic armour item: a plain item that reports a fixed runic charge. |
| [`OreDictionaryNames`](thaumcraft.api.md#oredictionarynames) | The 1.7.10 Forge ore dictionary names an add-on used, as 1.21.1 item tags. |
| [`ThaumcraftApi`](thaumcraft.api.md#thaumcraftapi) | The public registration facade of the native port. |
| [`ThaumcraftApiHelper`](thaumcraft.api.md#thaumcraftapihelper) | The original TC4 static helper surface. |
| [`ThaumcraftFX`](thaumcraft.api.md#thaumcraftfx) | The visual effects a 1.7.10 add-on sent to the players around a block with Thaumcraft's own packets. |
| [`ThaumcraftMaterials`](thaumcraft.api.md#thaumcraftmaterials) | The original TC4 material constants. |
| [`TileThaumcraft`](thaumcraft.api.md#tilethaumcraft) | The original TC4 base tile entity with its own custom NBT section and a custom update packet. |
| [`WorldCoordinates`](thaumcraft.api.md#worldcoordinates) | Immutable modern location. |
